ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a schematic diagram of the life cycle of a grasshopper/locust. In the lower right there is an egg-shaped object, labeled A beside it; in the lower middle there is a smaller, not fully developed grasshopper, labeled C below it; above there is a larger adult grasshopper, labeled D nearby. Reasoning: The sequence of the grasshopper life cycle is egg (egg) → nymph (nymph) → adult (adult). C is marked at the immature grasshopper stage between the egg and adult, so C represents nymph.
